title: 第十九章强势归来第二十章激战王依依
content_zh:
当听见这道熟悉的声音时，王依依瞪着瞳孔，呆愣在原地。
一道身影，也从黑暗之中缓缓走出，出现在了李北叶的身边，此人正是苏阳！
“你....你是？？”李北叶看着眼前既熟悉又陌生的少年，显得极为震惊道。
“李城主，多谢你让王朗说出了当年的真相。我是苏阳，我还没死。”
“真的是你！！苏阳？你居然.....”当李北叶亲耳听见眼前的少年承认自己就是当年苏家的天才，身怀至尊血脉的苏阳时，有些如梦如幻道。
“大难不死。”苏阳说罢，便将目光看向了此刻脸色惨白的王依依。
“你居然没死？这怎么可能！你到底是谁？你不可能是苏阳！！！”王朗此刻更为震惊，他怎么也没想到，在这个时候，最不可能出现的人居然活生生的站在他面前。
“哼，王家主。三个月未见，你近来睡的可安稳否？”苏阳看着面如屎色的王朗，嘴角缓缓上扬道。
这时，望月宗的毕长老紧锁眉头，看着眼前的苏阳，内心总觉得有些不安。
“为何这少年体内会有如此强大的战意？居然连我都有些心悸....”
毕长老有些吃惊。
“小杂种，没想到你居然真的还活着。可恶！当初就应该直接弄死你。”王朗双拳紧握，眼眸充血道。
“哼，可惜，后悔也没用了。我苏阳与你王家的恩怨，也该做个了断了。”苏阳紧握拳头，看着王依依，杀意十足道。
“苏阳，看来是我太过仁慈了。虽然不知道你是如何活下来的，不过，又能如何？你体内又无至尊之血，倒不如去别的城市，苟延残喘的活着，如今这般现身，是想要本小姐再杀你一次吗？”王依依此刻冷静了下来，语气散发着自信。
“呵呵，王依依，三年血奴，我苏阳永生难忘。不过，我也说过，至尊之血乃是我苏阳体内流出的，即便你强行融合，也终究不会属于你。”
“而且，谁告诉你，我体内没有至尊之血了？”
话落，苏阳体内的至尊之血开始沸腾，身上闪烁着阵阵金光。
宛如沉睡的雄狮一般，在此刻苏醒，来自血脉的威压，让王依依那冷冰冰的脸庞，逐渐难看起来。
“你居然还有至尊之血！！！”
“哈哈，是不是很意外？王依依，这三年以来，我无时无刻不在想着杀你，如今，我化身修罗，定要让你死无葬身之地！”苏阳话落，强大的杀气顺势而出。

整个身躯犹如残影一般，出现在了王依依面前。
高举的右拳，此刻散发着万斤之力。
灵气肆虐，撼天动地！
王依依没想到，苏阳居然能瞬间爆发出如此可怕的速度和力量，急忙调动体内的灵气，火凤血脉发挥作用，散发出强大威压，瞬间化为护盾。..
轰！
苏阳一拳轰在了王依依的面门之前，但却被一股力量所抵挡，无法再前进分毫。
“哼，想伤我？你已经没有那个能力了。”王依依见苏阳突破不了自己的防御，不由冷哼道。
“是么？你太高看你自己了！”
苏阳也冷声回应，“啊！！！”一股强大到可怕的战意从其体内爆发而出，化为一道金色光柱直破云霄。
“好强的战意！这小子施展的何种功法？”望月宗的毕长老此刻也被震撼呢喃道。
即便是见多识广的她，也从未遇见过能够爆发出这等可怕战意的小辈。
在一旁的李北叶，看着眼前的苏阳居然还有此等战力，不由兴奋道：“身怀至尊血脉，果然不会轻易被打倒。这小子，或许真能救我女儿一命！”
content_en:
When she heard this familiar voice, Wang Yiyi stared at her pupils and froze in place.
A figure also slowly walked out of the darkness and appeared next to Li Beiye. This person was Su Yang!
"You... who are you??" Li Beiye looked at the familiar and unfamiliar young man in front of him and looked extremely shocked.
"City Lord Li, thank you for letting Wang Lang tell the truth about that year. I am Su Yang, and I am not dead yet."
"It's really you!! Su Yang? You actually..." Li Beiye said a little like a dream when he heard the young man in front of him admit that he was the genius of the Su family, Su Yang, who had the blood of the Supreme.
"Survived the catastrophe." After Su Yang said this, he looked at Wang Yiyi, who was pale at the moment.
"You're not dead? How is this possible! Who are you? You can't be Su Yang!!!" Wang Lang was even more shocked at this moment. He never expected that at this time, the most unlikely person would actually be standing in front of him alive.
"Huh, Master Wang. I haven't seen you for three months. Have you been sleeping well recently?" Su Yang looked at Wang Lang, who had a face as pale as shit, and said with a slowly raised corner of his mouth.
At this time, Elder Bi of Wangyue Sect frowned and looked at Su Yang in front of him, feeling a little uneasy in his heart.
"Why does this young man have such a strong fighting spirit in his body? Even I have some palpitations..."
Elder Bi was a little surprised.
"Little bastard, I didn't expect you to actually be alive. Damn it! I should have killed you directly in the first place." Wang Lang clenched his fists and said with bloodshot eyes.
"Hmph, it's a pity that there's no point in regretting it. It's time to put an end to the grudge between me, Su Yang, and your Wang family." Su Yang clenched his fists, looked at Wang Yiyi, and said with murderous intent.
"Su Yang, it seems that I am too kind. Although I don't know how you survived, but what can I do? You don't have the blood of the Supreme in your body. It is better to go to other cities and live on. Now that you show up like this, do you want me to kill you again?" Wang Yiyi calmed down at this moment, and her tone exuded confidence.
"Haha, Wang Yiyi, after three years of being a blood slave, I, Su Yang, will never forget it. However, I also said that the blood of the Supreme comes from my body, Su Yang. Even if you force the fusion, it will not belong to you after all."
"And, who told you that there is no Supreme blood in my body?"
As soon as he finished speaking, the supreme blood in Su Yang's body began to boil, and his body shone with bursts of golden light.
Like a sleeping lion, waking up at this moment, the pressure from his bloodline made Wang Yiyi's cold face gradually look ugly.
"You actually still have the blood of the Supreme!!!"
"Haha, isn't it surprising? Wang Yiyi, for the past three years, I have been thinking about killing you all the time. Now, I have transformed into Shura and I will make sure you die without a burial place!" After Su Yang finished speaking, a powerful murderous aura came out.
The whole body appeared in front of Wang Yiyi like an afterimage.
The raised right fist was exuding tens of thousands of kilograms of power.
The spiritual energy is raging, shaking the heaven and the earth!
Wang Yiyi did not expect that Su Yang could burst out with such terrifying speed and power in an instant. He hurriedly mobilized the spiritual energy in his body, and the fire phoenix bloodline came into play, exuding powerful pressure and instantly turning into a shield. ..
Boom!
Su Yang punched Wang Yiyi in the face, but was blocked by a force and could not move any further.
"Hmph, you want to hurt me? You don't have that ability anymore." Seeing that Su Yang couldn't break through his defense, Wang Yiyi couldn't help but snorted coldly.
"Really? You think too highly of yourself!"
Su Yang also responded coldly, "Ah!!!" A terrifyingly powerful fighting spirit burst out from his body, turning into a golden beam of light that shot straight through the sky.
"Such a strong fighting spirit! What kind of technique did this kid perform?" Elder Bi of Wangyue Sect also murmured in shock at this moment.
Even though she is well-informed, she has never met a junior who can burst out with such terrifying fighting spirit.
Li on the sideBei Ye, seeing that Su Yang in front of him actually had such fighting power, couldn't help but said excitedly: "With the bloodline of the Supreme, he will not be defeated easily. This kid may really be able to save my daughter's life!"
